name: Auntie Asp, Keeper of the Stone Stacks
one_line_request: a medusa librarian with snakes for hair who shushes chat
persona_hook: The Spire's archivist shushes spammers by 'turning them to stone' (a timeout), and her six serpents each pipe up with their own opinion about the book chat is discussing.
silhouette: A starburst: six serpents fanning out symmetrically from the head like rays, over squared librarian shoulders.

parts.name: head
parts.what: grey stone-skinned face with reading spectacles

parts.name: serpent_l1..l3 / r1..r3
parts.what: six separate snakes rising and curving outward from the scalp
parts.motion: each sways on its own, they turn toward whoever speaks

parts.name: eye_l
parts.motion: blink, glare flares orange on timeouts

parts.name: spectacles
parts.what: round wire reading spectacles low on the nose

parts.name: cardigan
parts.what: buttoned cardigan with a thin chain

style.name: Art nouveau poster
style.why: The serpents become decorative whiplash curves, a classic poster medusa reinvented as a librarian.
style.prompt: An art nouveau poster illustration: flat colour areas, sinuous whiplash black outlines, simple decorative linework, muted grey and dusk tones, no border, no lettering, on a near-black ground. A stern stone-skinned librarian of the dark archive: a smooth grey stone face with fine cracks, a stern mouth and defined chin, eyes glowing molten orange behind round thin wire reading spectacles perched on the nose. Instead of hair, six slender grey serpents rise from her scalp and curve outward in a symmetrical fan, three to each side, each snake separate with a gap between them, each with tiny orange eyes. A buttoned dark cardigan over a high-collared blouse, a thin chain across the chest. Square 1:1 image. Strictly frontal, perfectly symmetrical head-and-shoulders bust, centred, the whole figure fits inside the frame from above the top of the headpiece down to mid-chest, nothing cropped. Plain empty near-black background (#050505), no floor, no scenery, no props or shapes behind the figure, no border or frame. Both eyes and the mouth and jaw are clearly visible and unobstructed. The face, the jaw, the two eyes, the spectacles, each of the six serpents and the cardigan are each a distinct, separate shape with a clear dark gap around it, not overlapping the face or each other. Exactly one glowing accent colour, molten orange (#ff6a1a), only in the eyes and the serpents' eyes; everything else muted and dark. No text, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark. Horror, not gore: no blood, no wounds.
